protocols.methodology: Protocol cut of pack fees, redemption-fee skims and zap fees, all accruing to the treasury.

protocols.name: Robin Labs
protocols.methodology: The protocol's share of trading fees, including the portion deferred until a coin graduates and the 25% treasury cut of above-default fee tiers, plus the protocol's graduation reward.

protocols.name: Robin
protocols.methodology: Same as fees: 100% of registration and renewal costs accrue to the protocol treasury (a 2-of-3 Safe). There are no third-party fee splits.

protocols.name: Loopr
protocols.methodology: Loopr's 30% cut of each basket's mint fee, the LOOPR token creator + protocol tax paid to Loopr's own wallet, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.

protocols.name: LienFi
protocols.methodology: Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and 10% of interest earned from property NFTs.

protocols.name: Aero Lite
protocols.methodology: Zero: no Voter/veAERO gauge system is deployed on Arc yet, so no fees are redirected away from LPs.

protocols.name: vibes.fun
protocols.methodology: 30% of fees: the share vibes.fun keeps, split between its treasury and $VIBES buyback and burn.

protocols.name: REP369
protocols.methodology: REP369 tax allocated to REP holder rewards plus the sell-side burn allocation. Automatic liquidity is treated as supply-side revenue.

protocols.name: StonkBrokers Broker Box
protocols.methodology: Broker Box protocol accrual (5% of ticket) + sell-back spread + the treasury half of the Certificate Counter fee.

protocols.name: Kiltr
protocols.methodology: Protocol share of swap fees (ProtocolFeesCollector / ProtocolFeeController percentage read live from kiltr.net/api/fees).

protocols.name: Archery V2
protocols.methodology: V2 swap fees routed to veArchery voters through gauges, equal to HoldersRevenue.

protocols.name: HumidiFi
protocols.methodology: HumidiFi's estimated daily trading PnL based on net inventory change. May diverge from actual net revenue if HumidiFi hedges inventory off-chain (CEX hedges, funding costs, etc.).

protocols.name: Hegic
protocols.methodology: The same as Fees, the Stake & Cover pool keeps all of its net premiums.

protocols.name: Azuro
protocols.methodology: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)

protocols.name: Spark Liquidity Layer
protocols.methodology: Fees collected minus the Sky Base Rate (vault stability fee) plus the monthly offchain rebate calculation for things like idle USDS.
